svg.title: Options A, B, C mapped to Make.com modules and calculator fields
svg.desc: Three automation options shown as module flows with calculator field mapping and coverage gaps

g.text: Webhook → classify only (LEAD / SPAM / SEEK / TEST)

svg.text: → setup CHF ~1,500 monthly CHF ~300 (base, no adders)

g.text: Webhook → classify + AI pre-reply draft for SEEK (human revision)

svg.text: ~9–11 modules: webhook, router, 4× move, OpenAI call, format prompt, create draft, notify
APIs: Gmail / IMAP + OpenAI (token cost per email!)
→ setup CHF ~2,000 monthly CHF ~450 (but misses: OpenAI token cost per email)

g.text: Email service + webhook → classify (LEAD / SPAM / SEEK / TEST)

svg.text: ~8–10 modules: email service setup + A's modules
Extra: email service API authentication + routing
APIs: email service (e.g. SendGrid) + Gmail / IMAP
→ setup CHF ~2,000 monthly CHF ~400 (but: which email service? its API plan cost not captured)
What the calculator does not capture (the gap)
1. Make.com module count — A=6, B=10, C=9 modules; more modules = more dev hours, not reflected
2. Number of classification categories — 4 folders vs 8 folders is twice the routing work
3. Operational costs — Make.com operations/month and OpenAI tokens/month are pass-through, not in quote
4. Which specific APIs — Gmail vs Outlook vs IMAP each has different auth/testing complexity
